tcm.note: The dried herb is warm; fresh fruit thinly documented.

effects.note: A smoothie mixing equal parts raspberry, blueberry, strawberry and blackberry improved executive function for several hours after drinking it in a controlled trial, plausibly through the same anthocyanin route credited to blueberry — though raspberry has less evidence on its own than blueberry does. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
